run_anonymizer_stage_async: run the AnonymizerStageService async to start anonymizer containers for a private computation instance
start_anonymizer_containers: start anonymizer containers for a private computation instance with optional server IPs
get_anonymizer_status: get the current status of the anonymizer stage for a private computation instance
stop_anonymizer_service: stop the anonymizer stage service and clean up containers for a private computation instance
init_anonymizer_stage_service: initialize an AnonymizerStageService with a OneDockerService and binary config map
